name: Unique Emblem: Blazing Conductor
main_effect:
[Main] You may play 1 [Elizamon] or [Owen Dreadnought] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Owen Dreadnought]s suspend, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait and the [LIBERATOR] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
